scoring_justification: Only easy-axis orientation is scored; no metric recompute against a quantitative energy target is required by the paper's claim. The check is structural: self-consistency of easy_axis with MAE sign and comparison to expected orientations from the paper.

schema.description: Each row corresponds to one slab system. The checker recomputes easy_axis from MAE sign and compares to hidden expected orientations; correct sign for all five systems earns full credit.

outputs.description: The single scored output containing computed MAE and easy-axis orientation for each of the five slab systems.

output_contract.notes: Only the sign of MAE (easy-axis orientation) is scored. Absolute MAE values are not evaluated.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected easy-axis orientations for each slab system from paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text: free-standing Fe and Co monolayers have in-plane anisotropy, Fe on Au/Ag/Pd have perpendicular anisotropy.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived directly from paper's stated results.
